faq:
Good questions. Straight answers.

STRAIGHT QUESTIONS.
STRAIGHT ANSWERS.

How much does junk removal cost?
  • Our minimum load price is $149.
  • The final quote depends on how much space your items take up, their type and weight, and access to the pickup area.
  • Confirm your price before loading begins.
  • Share your items and location for advice specific to your job.
  • Confirm details with the crew before scheduling.
Can I get same-day or next-day pickup?
  • Tell us your preferred day when requesting a quote.
  • Availability depends on the route and the size of your job; a pickup time must be confirmed with the crew.
Do I need to move everything outside?
  • Share where your items are located, including stairs, elevators, or narrow entryways.
  • We can plan the lifting and loading around your access details.
What items should I ask about first?
  • Let us know about paint, chemicals, fuel, batteries, tires, refrigerants, concrete, soil, or unusually heavy materials before scheduling.
  • Acceptance and any special handling must be confirmed.
What happens to the items after pickup?
  • Reusable and recyclable items may have options beyond disposal.
  • Ask about donation and recycling options for your specific items when you request a quote.

about:
ABOUT HAUL AMERICAN JUNK

LOCAL PEOPLE.
REAL ACCOUNTABILITY.
A BETTER WAY TO HAUL.

Homeowners deserve a crew they can count on. That’s why we’re here.

After years in the construction industry, we’ve seen how much the little things matter: answering the phone, explaining the price, and showing up when you say you will.

We started Haul American Junk because finding reliable help shouldn’t be the hardest part of cleaning up your property. We’re bringing a hands-on, family-owned approach to junk removal across southern DFW.

MEET YOUR NEXT CLEANOUT CREW →
THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK

CALEB CHRISTENSEN

Owner · U.S. Army Veteran

LOCAL & FAMILY-OWNED13F · 13 FOXTROT

Caleb served in the U.S. Army as a 13F (13 Foxtrot), a Fire Support Specialist. Today, he brings that same commitment to hard work and accountability to a locally owned, family-operated business.

Caleb is also the owner of Rugged American Exteriors, a Dallas–Fort Worth exterior business. Our construction background shapes the way we work: practical solutions, respect for your property, and a price you understand before the job starts.

LOCAL SERVICE. REAL PEOPLE.

SKIP THE CORPORATE
RUNAROUND.
CALL YOUR LOCAL CREW.

Call-center estimates. Extra fees that appear out of nowhere. A pickup truck that never arrives. We’ve seen how the national-franchise experience can let homeowners down—and we built Haul American Junk to do things differently.

Reach out to us and you’re speaking directly with the team coming to your property. We agree on a flat-rate quote before the first item gets lifted, and we arrive when we’ve told you to expect us.

We also look for a better destination than the dump. About 30% of the items we haul are donated or recycled, keeping usable goods and recoverable materials out of landfills.

  • Direct contact with the people doing your job
  • A flat-rate quote approved before work begins
  • Reliable arrivals and straightforward communication
  • Donation and recycling whenever suitable
